narrative.intro: Veterans Development obligated $71.5M in federal contracts in FY2027 to date. Veterans Development received 4 awards so far, with an average award size of $17.9M and obligations up 2024.0% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year show a varied pattern: Veterans Development obligated $11M in FY22, $18M in FY23, $2.3M in FY24, $24.1M in FY25, and $3.4M in FY26 before the current-year total. Top markets for Veterans Development in FY2027 to date concentrate in construction and support: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $70.8M and Facilities Support Services accounts for $693K. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity only. This profile shows where federal buying is concentrated and how recent activity compares with prior fiscal years, using only the reported obligation and market figures for Veterans Development.

sections.heading: How concentrated is Veterans Development's FY2027 to date business?
sections.body: Veterans Development obligated $71.5M in FY2027 to date, and Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $70.8M of that total. Veterans Development has 4 awards so far, with an average award size of $17.9M, so most current-year obligations are concentrated in one NAICS market. Facilities Support Services represents a much smaller share at $693K.

sections.heading: How does FY2027 to date compare with prior fiscal years?
sections.body: Veterans Development obligations in FY2027 to date are $71.5M versus $3.4M in FY26 and $24.1M in FY25. Veterans Development obligations were $2.3M in FY24, $18M in FY23, and $11M in FY22, and obligations are up 2024.0% year over year for the current fiscal-year-to-date total.
